# Engagement brief

## Need and intended outcome

Identify the client or user, the workflow, the current problem, and the useful change. Label hypotheses that have not been confirmed through discovery.

## Scope and ownership

Name the delivery owner, client decision maker, users or operators, deliverables, boundaries, dependencies, and responsibilities after delivery.

## Evidence and success criteria

Define the current baseline, evaluation conditions, metrics, acceptance criteria, and important failure cases. State which capability is already demonstrated and what needs an experiment or a partner.

## Constraints and commitments

Record access to data or equipment, integration constraints, cost and time assumptions, permitted use, and how changes will be agreed. For physical systems, identify operator authority and the permitted operating conditions.

## Next commitment

State the smallest useful next step, the evidence it will produce, and the conditions for continuing or stopping. Link the task and any decision record.
